Chapter 747 - 747 Heartbroken Kathleen; Chance!

Chapter 747 - 747 Heartbroken Kathleen; Chance!

747 Heartbroken Kathleen; Chance!

In the next moment, countless demons appeared in a radius of hundreds of miles.

They bared their fangs and brandished their claws, and their murderous aura surged into the sky, causing people’s hearts to tremble.

The Saint and Saintess of the Temple of Life shouted,””Not good, there’s an ambush!”

Ambush!

When the Temple of Life and the various factions hunted the demons and buddhas, the demons and buddhas wouldn’t sit still and wait for death. They would launch a series of counterattacks.

This time was an example.

The demons bared their fangs and brandished their claws. They roared nonstop and tore at the disciples of the Temple of Life.

The Saint and Saintess hurriedly led their disciples to resist.

The people from the Temple of Life were powerful, but there were too many demons and they were extremely ferocious.

Gradually, the members of the Temple of Life began to show signs of decline. Disciples were killed one after another.

The light of life around Kailin was like spring water that surged continuously. While killing the demons, she was also healing the disciples.

All the disciples felt her power and gathered towards her one after another, showing signs of respecting her.

When Lisa, Els, and Mike saw this, their gazes became extremely cold.

The three of them looked at each other as if they had made a decision. Then, they quietly approached Kathleen.

In the next moment…

The three of them suddenly attacked together and slapped Kathleen’s body.

“Boom!”

“Boom!”

“Boom!”

After three strikes, Kathleen felt as if her entire body was about to explode, and she spat out a large mouthful of blood.

She looked dispirited and looked at Lisa, Els, and Mike in disbelief.

These three people were once her good friends.

Although their relationship had indeed changed drastically in recent years.

However, Kathleen never thought that the other party would attack her.

Moreover, he was so decisive and ruthless!

His body and mind shattered!

Lisa, Els, and Mike did not think too much about it.

They attacked again, ready to give Kathleen a fatal blow.

“Tsk!”

At this moment, Kathleen’s body suddenly melted and disappeared in an instant, causing the three of them to hit nothing.

The three of them said in horror,”Shifting talisman!”

“Why does she have this?”

“Damn it!”

It was definitely a serious crime to injure a fellow disciple.

If word got out, the three of them would be severely punished.

Lisa, Els, and Mike did not immediately chase after him. Instead, they coldly swept their eyes across the scene.

“Kill them!”

The three of them quickly attacked and killed everyone on the scene with lightning speed.

The entire planet was dyed red.

It was ferocious and terrifying.

Then, the three of them quickly spread the news that Kathleen had betrayed the Temple of Life.

He even took out a variety of ‘evidence.’

Obviously, they had already made ample preparations.

This sneak attack was premeditated!

Originally, Kathleen wanted to return to the Temple of Life to recuperate.

However, before he could enter the Temple of Life, he was surrounded.

She had no choice but to run away in a sorry state.

Kathleen dragged her tired body and walked aimlessly in the vast universe alone. A sense of loneliness and helplessness surged into her heart like a tide.

Betrayed by a good friend, hunted down by the sect.

The entire world turned dark.

Just as Kathleen was in despair, a ray of light suddenly appeared in her world.

The light gradually turned into a tall and handsome figure.

It was Lin Fan.

Kailin could not help but think back to what Lin Fan had said about him in the Four Seasons Universe. After a moment of hesitation, she left.

….

On the other hand.

33 Heavens.

Bo Han’s face twisted as black smoke surrounded him.

“Roar!”

He faced the sky and roared, erupting with monstrous hostility. The entire world shook violently.

In the recent years, the curse that Bo Han had suffered was getting stronger and stronger.

Helpless, he could only put down everything and resist with all his might.

He could still hold on for a short period of time, but after a long time, he finally exploded.

His entire person was extremely deranged as he shouted sternly,”Bodhi Fruit, you’re really going too far!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he jumped up and flew into the endless sky.

Clearly, Han Bo had placed the curse on the Bodhi Fruit.

This was something that couldn’t be helped. Everyone knew that the Bodhi Fruit was a karma sainthood!

And the only one who could curse a Sacred Master was a Sacred Master!

Therefore, the Demon Realm and the Sea Realm formed an alliance and began to fight against the Buddha Realm together.

An even greater chaos spread out rapidly.

….

On the other hand, in the Ancient Mystic Realm.

“Ta Ta!”

Li Ke walked forward carefully, one step at a time.

These years of exploration made him understand that there were many opportunities and dangers in the Ancient Mystic Realm. He had to be careful.

A moment later, Li Ke’s attention was drawn to a wide, charred cave not far away.

He could not help but think to himself,’What a dense fire attribute power… Could there be a fire-type treasure inside?”

After hesitating for a moment, Li Ke decided to go in and take a look.

Perhaps there would be danger.

However, there might also be powerful opportunities.

The moment he stepped into the secret realm, Li Ke’s blood boiled and his heart pounded.

It had such an effect just outside!

There was definitely an extraordinary opportunity inside!

Li Ke couldn’t help but quicken his pace.

“Roar!”

In the next moment, a Fire Qilin that was dozens of meters tall suddenly rushed toward Li Ke with a hot airwave. It opened its bloody mouth and bit at Li Ke.

Li Ke’s expression changed slightly. The flames around his body surged and instantly turned into a fire dragon. He entangled with the Fire Qilin. Explosions kept coming, and the cave shook as if it would collapse at any time.

“Puff!”

After fighting for a long time, Li Ke finally killed the Fire Qilin at the cost of serious injuries.

Li Ke hugged the Fire Qilin’s neck and continued to absorb its golden blood.

“Phew!”

“Suck!”

The pure fire-attribute energy surged through Li Ke’s body like a tsunami, causing mysterious golden flame runes to appear on his body.

This might be the opportunity in the cave!

When Li Ke was about to leave, he suddenly found a fiery red bead in the depths of the cave.

As long as he got close, the fire attribute energy would increase by a bit.

Treasure, this was definitely a rare treasure!

This was probably the reason why the Fire Qilin was so powerful!

Li Ke reached out and took the bead in his hand.

“Boom!”

Suddenly, a monstrous flame soared into the sky with Li Ke as the center and condensed into a huge fire dragon.

The entire sky was burned red by the fire dragon, as if doomsday had arrived. It was extremely terrifying.

Everyone in the Ancient Mystic Realm raised their heads and looked in the direction of the fire dragon. Shock was written on their faces as they discussed.

“What’s that?”

“What a terrifying aura!”

“The great opportunity of the Ancient Mystic Realm has been discovered!”

“Although it is of the fire attribute, it is still worth a look!”

….

Countless people gathered in the direction of the fire dragon, wanting to fight for the opportunity for the last time.

However, their actions were clearly just false.

Because everything was already done.
